candidate.answerReason: Seven annual contests span six one-year gaps, placing the seventh in 1991. Subtracting 12 gives birth year 1979.

methods.label: Count the gaps between contests
methods.explanation:
The first contest is already counted in \(1985\), so reaching the seventh contest requires only \(7-1=6\) one-year gaps. The seventh AMC \(8\) was therefore held in \(1985+6=1991\).

Samantha turned \(12\) that year, so her birth year was
\[
1991-12=1979.
\]
The answer is \(1979\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary counting of events versus gaps, followed by calendar-year arithmetic.
